description: Root cause #2's fix (diagnostic visibility) is two plain literal-list/number edits with zero automated regression coverage: (1) skills/self/verify-loops.sh:77 changed the self-fix marker loop from 'for L in capafy-loop reddit-loop mr-bot-loop' to a hardcoded 10-name list ('clip-loop affiliate-loop video-loop gig-loop bounty-loop pm-earner-loop founder-loop capafy-loop reddit-loop mr-bot-loop'); (2) skills/self/verify-loops-audit.sh:93 changed 'cut -c1-900' to 'cut -c1-3000'. Neither the exact loop-name list nor the cut-length is asserted by any test — grep across skills/self/tests/* for the literal list or for '3000'/'900' finds nothing (test_verify_loops_audit_reddit_liveness.sh only covers the reddit-liveness OR-condition, a separate change in the same file). A future edit that silently drops a loop name from the list, or that shrinks the cut back down, would not be caught by the test suite; the only way to notice would be manually reading the script or waiting for the exact same invisible-diagnosis failure mode root cause #2 already produced once. I independently confirmed (by reading real self-fix result markers under ~/.openclaw/state/.self-fix-*.result) that all 10 expected '-loop'-suffixed filenames actually exist today and match this new list verbatim, so the CURRENT wiring is correct — the gap is purely the absence of a regression test locking that correctness in place.

evidence.snippet: for L in clip-loop affiliate-loop video-loop gig-loop bounty-loop pm-earner-loop founder-loop capafy-loop reddit-loop mr-bot-loop; do r="$HOME/.openclaw/state/.self-fix-$L.result"; [ -f "$r" ] && echo "  [$L] $(cat "$r")"; done
